<title level="1" right="Action">[Liberating Bite](/Actions.aspx?ID=2786) <actions string="Single Action" /></title>

<traits>
<trait label="Flourish" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=606" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 92

</column>

---

The mongoose makes a jaws Strike that can help creatures break free of restraint, like the grasp of a cobra. If the Strike hits, each creature [grappled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=77) or [restrained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=90) by the target can [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=2296) as a free action.
name: Liberating Bite
